title: Test import retry after SQL commit before journal discard without duplicate records or events
outcome: Test import retry after SQL commit before journal discard without duplicate records or events
acceptance: A deterministic Rust fixture crashes after the ordinary import's SQL commit and before its journal discard, then retries the same import
After retry, SQLite has exactly one work_items row per task id, no repeated version event and no reminted local record identity
The journal slot's retained or discarded state matches the recorded comparison basis, and a further ordinary operation succeeds without rebuilding
The test runs after the 808a landing and introduces no new gate or background watcher
